title: Researcher claims every Mac since 2022 runs an undocumented personal knowledge graph
summary: A researcher posting as infwhispers has published an investigation at 8rank.ai arguing that every Mac released since 2022 ships a pair of undocumented daemons that build a personal knowledge graph — who the user is, who they know, how those people relate to each other, and how, where, and when the user communicates with them — including what the title calls a family-member classifier. The author confirmed authorship in the discussion thread and linked follow-up research on the knowledge graph. The claims are the researcher&\#x27;s own reverse-engineering analysis rather than an Apple announcement: no Apple documentation or independent verification of the daemons&\#x27; scope appears in the supplied material, and the post describes a capability that is already shipping rather than a new release.
